The licence is as Commons records it. Identified as this saint because: Plate 10051 of the Russian Lives of the Saints (1903-1911), whose numbering puts it on 5 June - the folder's feast day. Captioned Dorofey and filed under Category:Dorotheus of Tyre, the bishop of this folder's office line. The second plate of the day, 10052, is Anuvy.
